facts.fact: The FY2026/27 recurrent provision of P108,505,050 for department 0411 Civil and National Registration, from the Consolidated Fund, is stated by the minister to cover among others the maintenance of the Births and Deaths Registration System, with Omang production and the National Identification System; no share for the BDRS is given.

The budget line that maintains the Births and Deaths Registration System in FY2026/27 is held by the Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs' Department of Civil and National Registration (organisation 0400, department 0411).
